subject: JC IMP-1: capture must not downgrade a poller-scored posting
description: Documented gap 1a: a DOM-scraped capture with slightly different content from the poller's for the same job triggers upsert_posting's content-hash path -> nulls fit_score/fit_rationale + resets status='new', bouncing a scored job back to unscored. Fix: add write_source='poller'|'capture' to upsert_posting; a capture write onto a row that already has fit_score preserves content+score (poller API text authoritative), just bumps last_seen_at. capture.ingest passes write_source='capture'. Poller path unchanged (default). Build -> Nancy -> Chris -> commit.
